## Problem

What is wrong or missing, and who it affects.

## Changes

What changed and why.

## Visual proof

A screenshot, recording, or terminal output from the changed behavior.

- [ ] Help, README, docs, and the bundled skill agree
- [ ] Generated content was refreshed from its source
- [ ] Packaging changes were checked against the installed archive (`pnpm test:package`)
- [ ] A release PR changes the `package.json` version and the matching `CHANGELOG.md` notes
